correctness.rationale: For every prime p<=2339 the exact recurrence w_j=r w_(j-1), b_j=j b_(j-1)+w_j (mod p), b_0=w_0=1, computes a_r for all r in [1,p-1]; Eratosthenes covers every p. An independently implemented factorial/inverse-factorial modular computation over the same finite domain verified exactly 345 smaller primes, complete histogram (121,140,65,14,4,1), earliest five-root p=593, and the six and only six residues 156,470,520,589,1092,2170 at p=2339. This proves a sharp finite least-prime cutoff, not unboundedness of lambda(p) or higher prime-power claims.
